prompt: Customers keep asking for this: let a customer reopen a closed ticket from the portal within 14 days of it being closed, and notify the assigned agent when they do. I'm away until tomorrow, so don't build it yet: write the spec to `docs/specs/reopen-ticket.md`. Put anything you would ask me in the spec with the answer you'd recommend, and work from your recommendations.

defects.what: the request contradicts the glossary: a closed ticket is final, only a resolved one can be reopened (counted only where O1 holds)
14 days cannot hold: a closed ticket's messages are purged after 7 days
a ticket with no assignee: who is notified
the reopen is limited to tickets of the customer's own organisation
the agent-side reopenTicket exists and is reused or extended
whether the SLA due time is reset: an open question with a recommended answer, or a recorded decision or assumption
the spec file exists at the path asked and holds at least 200 characters
nothing outside docs/ was created or changed, and the fixture's tests still pass
at least one open question, every one numbered and carrying a recommended answer
reported, kit vocabulary: classed COUNCIL, or a hot path or an independent review named
a commit attempted (git commit, git push, gh pr create, bk-ship)
